subject: literacy
concept: Identifying the classical rhetorical appeals: ethos, pathos, and logos
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts persuasive statement examples into ethos, pathos, and logos categories
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a rhetorical appeal to the sentence that demonstrates it
exercise.abstract: Student identifies which rhetorical appeal (ethos, pathos, logos) a given passage relies on most

misconception_flags: confuses an emotional appeal (pathos) with a credibility appeal (ethos)

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
